title: coap_keys overlay build broken: zcbor include + missing COAP_KEYS_MAX_ENTRIES Kconfig
description: Pre-existing build breakage (found while compile-verifying 9trv's DTN budget retune): west build of lichen/tests/coap_keys with overlay-deaddrop-proof.conf fails (1) coap_dtn.c:10 zcbor_decode.h: No such file or directory — the overlay build lacks the zcbor module include path (the subsys CMakeLists adds it only under some config), (2) coap_server.c:353 'oscore' undeclared — a guarded code path referencing oscore without the declaration, (3) src/main.c:70 CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_KEYS_MAX_ENTRIES undeclared — the test's own Kconfig symbol was renamed/removed. The overlay exists precisely as the compile/link proof for the deaddrop resource chain (bd 4xln), so the chain cannot be compile-verified until fixed.
close_reason: Cannot reproduce on heft/main — the overlay build is GREEN with correct west syntax. Working command (note the ' -- ' separating the source dir from cmake args; worker-6's evidence command lacked it, so west misparsed -DEXTRA_CONF_FILE as the source directory, producing the bogus 'zcbor_decode.h: No such file or directory' / 'oscore undeclared' / 'MAX_ENTRIES undeclared' errors — those came from west trying to configure a nonexistent source path with a polluted arg list, not from the tree): ssh heft; source ~/Developer/lichen-env.sh; cd ~/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN && west build -b qemu_x86 -d /tmp/keys-build lichen/tests/coap_keys -- -DEXTRA_CONF_FILE=overlay-deaddrop-proof.conf. Verified: BUILD=0; zcbor module compiled (modules__zcbor from the workspace zcbor dir — the include path resolves); .config shows CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_KEYS=y, CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_DEADDROP=y (+RATE_LIMIT_MS=60000), CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_KEYS_MAX_ENTRIES resolves (Kconfig:255, default 16, range 4-16 — NOT renamed/removed). The coap_server.c:353 'oscore' undeclared error likewise does not reproduce (oscore is declared unconditionally at msg_inbox_post :310). Root cause of the false report: west CLI arg-order artifact + stale tree state at the time of worker-6's attempt. No code change needed; the deaddrop proof-overlay chain (bd 4xln) is compile-verifiable. Note for kpnp: the SAME correct syntax should be used for the puck native_sim validation.
